title: 明月栞那 · 星光咖啡馆的白色花嫁
description: 【星光咖啡馆露台·清晨】栞那穿着带围裙式腰饰的白色婚纱，站在刚开店的露台旁，把咖啡豆与小白花一起放进捧花；她闻到第一炉点心的香气便弯起眼睛，像把日常工作变成了婚礼。
action: 咖啡馆开店前把咖啡豆与小白花放入捧花，闻到点心香后放松微笑
lighting: soft morning light over the pastry window
mood: 把长年手艺写进花嫁日常
promptProse: Kanna Akizuki from YUZUSOFT wears a white bridal dress with a café-apron waist detail, rose-gold buttons and a small coffee-flower bouquet. She stands on the café terrace before opening, arranging a few coffee beans and small white flowers within the bouquet. The first pastry aroma reaches her and turns her practiced smile into a relaxed one, while the pale veil catches the morning light above the quiet shop. soft morning light over the pastry window.

title: 朝田诗乃 · 静音礼堂里的蓝色花嫁
description: 【郊外小教堂·清晨】诗乃穿着剪裁简洁的蓝白婚纱站在钢琴旁，黑框眼镜被换成细小的银色发饰；她指尖轻触捧花上的蓝色小花，面对镜头时的安静笑容像一段终于完成的旋律。
location: small countryside chapel with an upright piano
action: 钢琴旁整理银色发饰并轻触蓝花捧花，安静回眸微笑
lighting: clear morning light and pale blue window glow
mood: 现实世界里的安静誓约
promptProse: Shino Asada from Sword Art Online wears a blue-and-white bridal gown with a simple veil, silver hair ornament and a small blue bouquet. She stands beside the chapel piano with a small blue bouquet resting against her gloves. She touches one blue flower in the bouquet, then looks toward the viewer with a quiet smile as sunlight crosses the polished keys and the veil settles behind her. clear morning light and pale blue window glow.

title: 山田杏奈 · 夏日祭典木屐磨脚的长椅依靠·「木屐带子磨得脚好痛……市川，能让我靠一会儿吗」
description: 【神社夏祭烟花树下石阶长椅·夜】夏夜祭典穿浴衣的难耐时刻。山田穿着藏青色金鱼花纹浴衣，因为不习惯木屐脚跟被磨红，只得脱下一只木屐坐在树下石凳上。她有些难为情地把头轻轻靠在市川肩膀上，手里还拿着苹果糖，烟花在夜空中炸开，照亮她动情的侧颜。
action: 脱木屐揉脚踝，歪头依靠在身侧肩膀，烟花夜空下低语
lighting: 夜空烟花多重绚烂彩光与古树下纸灯笼
camera: medium shot, sitting on stone bench, yukata, fireworks, leaning on shoulder
promptProse: Anna Yamada rests on a stone bench beneath an ancient cedar tree during the summer shrine fireworks festival, clad in a rich indigo yukata with white goldfish motifs. Having slipped off one wooden geta sandal to nurse a blistered heel, she leans her head affectionately against your shoulder, holding a half-eaten candy apple. Brilliant bursts of multicolored fireworks blossom in the night sky above, illuminating the tender flush on her cheek and the small beauty mark on her neck.
